title: Broadband Connectivity and Cabin Wi-Fi Fitment Request for the Evo Sub-Fleet
abstract: Operator asks for a factory-supported broadband connectivity and cabin Wi-Fi installation across its Evo sub-fleet, having found that the third-party supplemental type certificate route conflicts with its cabin layout and its planned cabin refresh.

sections.request: We committed to free onboard Wi-Fi for our passengers from the 2027 summer season and we have been quoted for a third-party installation. Two things stopped us. First, the proposed equipment rack sits exactly where our cabin refresh puts a new stowage, and second, the electrical load calculation the vendor gave us assumes a spare rating on the rectifier units that our aircraft do not appear to have. We would much rather buy an Aeralis solution that is designed around the aircraft we actually operate. What we need is the antenna, the server, the access points in the ceiling and the cabin management tie-in, all covered by one approval, and we need it to work with the cabin lighting scenes we already have. We fly six aircraft with a further four on order and we would like the retrofit to be embodiable overnight or across a weekend rather than in a heavy check.
sections.background: An initial study by our engineering department in late 2025 concluded that the supplemental type certificate offered by the vendor would need a separate electrical load analysis and a separate cabin layout approval, which together add roughly nine months to the programme. Our aircraft are all delivered after 2021 and already carry the current cabin management standard. We have no in-service issues to report; this is a commercial fitment request rather than a reliability one.
sections.expected_outcome: A single Aeralis modification covering the antenna, the server, the wireless access points and the cabin management interface, released with a retrofit bulletin that fits a two-night ground period. The solution must not consume the stowage volume reserved by our cabin refresh and must come with a validated electrical load statement.

type_data.business_justification: Connectivity is contracted into the operator's 2027 product promise. A nine-month delay caused by the supplemental type certificate route would push the fitment past the season it was sold for.
